candidates.buyer: Small trucking firms, civil contractors and soil-yard operators carrying construction soil (about 6,000 trucks a day needed; 5,303 GPS applications by Jan 2026)
candidates.category: 27/31. Construction surplus soil (營建剩餘土石方) hauling
candidates.existing: State e-manifest app plus soilmove system (free). GPS box vendors sell hardware (one lists NT$380 for a unit said to meet both NLMA and MOENV specs). Taichung has its own city app. Competitor search found no SaaS that links dispatch, manifests and cost or disposal-fee books.
candidates.known_note: K02 is renovation-waste hauler declarations; this is a different duty (excavated soil e-manifest and GPS) and a different buyer (soil hauliers and civil contractors).
candidates.name: Soil-hauling e-manifest and GPS compliance and dispatch tool for small hauling firms and civil contractors
candidates.trigger: NLMA full-flow soil regime from 1 Jan 2026: every trip needs an e-manifest at each entry and exit point, plus GPS approved under MOI's 18 July 2025 vehicle tracking spec; small trucks now allowed; Waste Disposal Act amendment pending to add national flow reporting and penalties
candidates.unchecked: Whether the state app already covers dispatch and ledgers; whether there is an API or data export; hauler count and willingness to pay; how pending Waste Disposal Act changes will affect it; whether the GPS vendors bundle fleet software.

candidates.buyer: About 10,000 land scriveners (地政士) plus real-estate broker firms; small offices
candidates.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers: AML
candidates.evidence: https://www-ws.land.ntpc.gov.tw/001/upload/oldfile/userfiles/fe/file/地政士及不動產經紀業防制洗錢辦法-總說明與逐條說明.pdf ; https://landoffice.chcg.gov.tw/files/行政院公報_124_1140409.pdf ; https://landoffice.chcg.gov.tw/files/16附件地政士及不動產經紀業防制洗錢問答集_122_1120627.pdf
candidates.existing: Competitor search found no named software; only official Q&A and form templates from land offices. Guilds may hand out forms (unchecked).
candidates.name: AML and trust-filing compliance kit for land scriveners and real-estate brokers
candidates.trigger: Money Laundering Control Act designation; MOI AML and counter-terrorism-financing measures; NT$500k cash reports to MJIB; March 2025 MOI order on trust information filings within 30 days of creation or change; MOI risk assessment June 2025
candidates.unchecked: Enforcement data and fine levels; broker and scrivener association tools; the CDD duty cannot be outsourced to a third party, which limits some designs; willingness to pay; MJIB reporting channel.

candidates.buyer: About 12,551 legal B&Bs plus operators trying to become legal
candidates.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals
candidates.evidence: https://news.pts.org.tw/article/790082 ; https://wantrich.chinatimes.com/news/20250818900280-420501 ; https://files.chcg.gov.tw/files/民宿新版營運報表操作手冊(業者版)_38_1100104.pdf ; https://www.inside.com.tw/article/13441-fullinn-hotels-running-solution
candidates.existing: Counties provide free operating-report portals (e.g. Changhua manual); PMS vendors such as Fullinn sell booking and payment tools. No tax-threshold tool found.
candidates.name: B&B (minshuku) compliance and tax-threshold tracker with half-yearly operating report export
candidates.trigger: Regulation on B&B management: half-yearly report (January and July) of occupancy, guests and revenue; business tax tiers by monthly sales (under NT$50k exempt, NT$50k to 200k quarterly assessed at 1%, NT$200k and above uniform invoices at 5%); April 2025 amendment raises fines to NT$2m
candidates.unchecked: Whether PMS products already export the half-year report; willingness to pay of B&B owners; how many operators are exposed to the new fines and want legalisation help.

candidates.buyer: Small low-pollution unregistered factories in managed status, plus fastener and metal job shops
candidates.evidence: https://www.cto.moea.gov.tw/FactoryMCLA/upload/law_upload/1-3-宣導圖卡1120131_農產業群聚地區管理輔導宣導圖.pdf ; https://www.cto.moea.gov.tw/FactoryMCLA/upload/law_upload/特登辦法部分條文修正總說明及對照表.pdf
candidates.existing: None found; likely consultants and architects do the paperwork.
candidates.name: Special factory registration and counselling-fee manager for unregistered low-pollution factories
candidates.trigger: Factory Management and Counselling Act 2019 amendment: annual counselling fee due by 19 March; improvement plan; special factory registration or relocation; stated outer deadline 19 March 2030 in a MOEA flyer
candidates.unchecked: Current deadlines and any 2026 extension; count of factories still unregistered; whether this is a document-assembly service rather than software; local-government portals.

candidates.buyer: Management committees and managers of small condos, plus small property-management firms
candidates.evidence: https://www.north.taichung.gov.tw/media/1312737/公寓大廈管理負責人申請報備表格-1150202pdf.pdf ; https://6laws.net/6law/law3/公寓大廈管理報備事項處理原則.htm
candidates.existing: Not searched (budget); likely existing community-management apps.
candidates.name: Condo management committee filing and public-fund bookkeeping tool
candidates.trigger: Public Apartment Building Management Act: reporting of the management body or manager to local authority; Taichung online-only filing from 1 Jan 2026 via the Le-Ju portal
candidates.unchecked: Whether other cities moved online; recurring duties beyond the first filing; vendors; whether the buyer pays; fire and lift inspections already overlap with K03.

candidates.buyer: Small operators of toxic and concerned chemicals (workshops, labs, small factories, dealers)
candidates.evidence: https://6laws.net/6law/law3/毒性化學物質運作及釋放量紀錄管理辦法.htm ; https://iweb20wp-b205b.url.tku.edu.tw/environment/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/T006毒性及關注化學物質運作與釋放量紀錄管理辦法.pdf
candidates.existing: State reporting portal (MOENV) exists; no vendor search done. Likely covered by free state tool.
candidates.name: Toxic and concerned chemical operation-record reporting assistant
candidates.trigger: Rule on operation and release records: online report by the 10th of the month at the interval set per chemical (monthly, quarterly or half-yearly); keep records 3 years
candidates.unchecked: Number of small operators; whether the state portal imports ERP data; 2025 amendments; precursor chemicals not checked.

candidates.buyer: Small clinics (many thousand) that can now outsource EMR and use Taiwan public cloud
candidates.evidence: Search summaries of ithome.com.tw news (e.g. https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/152057); page itself returned 403 so the date and details are unverified
candidates.existing: Established clinic software vendors (not searched). Fewer than 10 vendors reportedly able to meet the draft requirement.
candidates.name: Clinic EMR outsourcing and cloud migration service under the 2026 EMR rule
candidates.trigger: Reported new MOHW EMR rule (published about 18 July 2026): outsourcing allowed; in-Taiwan cloud; vendor certification; clinic stays liable
candidates.unchecked: The real rule text and date; certification list; whether this is just generic EMR (excluded as generic) or creates a compliance pack; competition.

candidates.buyer: Small online and wine shops that would register under the amended Act
candidates.name: Online alcohol-sale seller registration and age-check compliance
candidates.trigger: Executive Yuan draft amendment to the Tobacco and Alcohol Administration Act allowing conditional online sales; passage not confirmed
candidates.unchecked: Whether the amendment passed; effective date; registration process.

candidates.name: Security guard roster and disqualification screening for security firms
candidates.trigger: Security Services Act amendment draft: regulator periodic checks, duty to dismiss disqualified guards, penalties
candidates.unchecked: Passage and date; number of firms; whether the checks are done by police data.

candidates.buyer: Small processors of imported fish exporting to the EU
candidates.name: EU-bound seafood processor IUU catch-certificate check log
candidates.trigger: Regulation (EC) 1005/2008 processing declarations signed by BSMI branches; 5-year retention of verification
candidates.unchecked: Number of firms; whether existing seafood ERP covers it; whether Taiwan has an import-side catch-document rule.

candidates.name: Retail LPG cylinder test-date and weight-check tracker for gas dealers (瓦斯行)
candidates.trigger: Fire-safety hazardous-goods rule Art. 75: cylinders must be sent for re-test before expiry; BSMI weight checks every six months; MOL cap of 1,000 kg for linked cylinders in factories
candidates.unchecked: Whether there is a periodic filing; dealer count; whether the big LPG firms already run tracking.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Two searches returned nothing on current Taiwan reporting duties for fuel stations. For LPG: Energy Administration tracks supply, filling and sales weight (CNA Dec 2024); cylinder re-test deadlines fall on sellers under the fire-safety hazardous-goods rules (Art. 75, per Control Yuan record). No software gap confirmed. Nothing new beyond weak LPG cylinder-expiry idea (unverified).

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Grain Management Act requires grain-dealer registration (糧商登記) with COA branch offices and source records on request. No periodic filing system found. Nothing actionable.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Savings-and-loan cooperatives (儲蓄互助社) report operating data to their association (Art. 28); the 2016 co-op accounts audit rule was repealed. No current e-filing portal found. Nothing new; the 2024-26 amendment status is unverified.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: A 2026 news item says MOHW published a new EMR rule (about 18 July) that lets providers outsource EMR systems and use public cloud inside Taiwan, with vendor certification. I could not open the source (403) or confirm the date or effect. Clinic EMR is a crowded generic space. Radiation-source registration for clinic X-ray runs through NUSC's online system (not checked further). Listed as unverified.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Toxic and concerned chemical operators must keep operation records and report online by the 10th of the month (monthly, quarterly or half-yearly) and keep records 3 years (2019 rule, in force 2020-01-16). Reports go to the local environment authority through a state portal. Pharmacy and precursor angle not reached. Weak candidate listed.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Security Services Act amendment draft (Executive Yuan) loosens disqualification rules and adds regulator periodic screening and a duty to dismiss; passage unverified. No roster-filing portal found. Cleaning and manpower not reached.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Strongest lead: since 1 Jan 2026 the NLMA full-flow regime for construction surplus soil requires e-manifests and approved GPS on every hauling vehicle (5,303 GPS applications, 4,260 cleared; small trucks now allowed). Contractor registration search (Construction Industry Act, 2025-26 amendments, site name registers) found nothing new.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Land scriveners and real-estate brokers are designated non-financial AML entities: ID and beneficial-owner checks, sanctions screening, CTR for cash of NT$500k or more to MJIB, and since a March 2025 MOI order trust information filings to MOI within 30 days (and 30 days after changes). MOI's June 2025 risk assessment says 880 scriveners responded, about 8.4% of those in practice (so roughly 10,000), plus brokers. No dedicated software found.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Tourism Administration: 15,832 legal hotels and B&Bs and 1,624 illegal ones; tougher fines (up to NT$2m) after an April 2025 amendment; Taipei cuts water and power from 1 Jan 2026. B&Bs must submit half-yearly operating stats (January and July) through county portals and follow tax thresholds (NT$50k and NT$200k a month). Existing PMS tools exist (e.g. Fullinn), but no tax-threshold tool was found.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: BSMI branch rules: Taiwanese processors exporting fish to the EU must check IUU catch certificates and keep 5 years of records. Timber legality: no Taiwan rule found. K01 already covers food traceability (FTracebook).

coverage.category: 31. Construction surplus soil (土方) hauling and soil-yard operators
coverage.found: See the soil candidate. Law reform to add soil flow to the Waste Disposal Act is pending, so the duty may harden.

coverage.category: 32. Unregistered and low-pollution factories moving to special factory registration (特定工廠登記)
coverage.found: Factory Management and Counselling Act: managed unregistered factories pay an annual counselling fee by 19 March and must reach registration or relocate. Latest deadline appears to run to 19 March 2030 per a MOEA flyer (flyer may cover farm-industry clusters only). Unverified.

coverage.category: 33. Condominium management committees and managers (公寓大廈管理組織)
coverage.found: Reporting of management bodies is mandatory with the local government; Taichung has required online filing only since 1 Jan 2026 (Taichung Le-Ju portal). Other cities unverified. Public fund rules exist but no filing duty was found.

coverage.category: 34. Tobacco and alcohol sellers (菸酒管理法)
coverage.found: Draft amendment would allow conditional online alcohol sales with seller registration, convenience-store pickup and higher fines (NT$50k to 250k); passage unverified. Spot-check duties found only for ethanol sellers (monthly report, sales detail, proof of use above 5 litres).

coverage.category: 35. Cram schools and after-school centres (補習班, 安親班)
coverage.found: Registered under the Supplementary and Continuing Education Act with local education bureaus; standard contract and refund rules in the 2021 Short-Term Cram School Standards; local management systems exist. The Control Yuan flagged unregistered schools. Nothing software-shaped found.

coverage.category: 36. X-ray and radiation-source users in clinics, dental offices and vet practices
coverage.found: Ionizing Radiation Protection Act: a protection officer and dose records. NUSC runs an online cloud system for registration and changes. A draft amendment adds dose constraints. No filing gap found.

coverage.category: 37. Vehicle repair shops and motorcycle shops (waste oil, tyre records)
coverage.found: The only search returned Hong Kong results; the Taiwan duty and portal name are unverified.
UDI labelling and database upload duties fall on licence holders (importers and makers), not retailers; staged dates were 2021 to 2023 (FDA notice). No retailer-level duty found.
